title: Nashville SkyHaus - As Seen on MTV | Sleeps 12+
description:
Jersey Shore Family Vacation House of 2024! Stay where the stars really did in Nashville's premier vacation home. 4 stories of modern luxury, Nashville's SkyHaus boasts 4 beds / 5 full baths with enough beds for 12+ guests. Large rooftop includes fire pit, grill, pool table, 85" TV, and retro viewfinder. Cook up a storm in any of our 3 kitchens, Netflix & chill in our spacious living or from any of our 5 TVs. Uber to downtown —only 3 mi to Broadway.  Includes 2 car garage + private parking pad.

The space
4 story home features 9 beds, 5 full baths, and 4 private bedrooms with 3 common spaces which include more sleeping options. Epic rooftop views with patio furniture, rooftop grill, chefs kitchen, 2 kitchenettes on floor 1 and 4 and elevator.

See pictures for the above view layout of each floor.

Guest access
Guest has access to entire house except for locked closet in garage.

Other things to note
No unauthorized parties at our property. This will result in immediate eviction and $1,000 minimum fine.
